p1_findings.title: GET /api/search never wired in app.ts — production 404
p1_findings.description: The DependencyPicker typeahead calls searchItems() → GET /api/search → 404 in production. The route file, client function, and 5 test cases all exist but the route is never mounted in app.ts. Tests are committed in a known-failing state.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any user interacting with the DependencyPicker gets a 404. Feature is entirely non-functional in production.
p1_findings.impact: Work item dependency search is broken. All 5 search.test.ts cases fail. DependencyPicker UI is non-functional.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts (filter getAll() items by title/description, skip deleted, return {data: WorkItem[]}), mount at /api/search in app.ts. One-sprint fix.

p2_findings.title: pending_dependencies missing from WorkItemStatus enum
p2_findings.description: api-contracts.md and FR-dependency-dispatch-gating require a pending_dependencies state transition when a dispatch is blocked by unresolved dependencies. The status does not exist in the WorkItemStatus enum. Code returns a 400 error instead. Cascade auto-advance also broken.
p2_findings.impact: Dispatch-gating spec cannot be implemented. Cascade auto-advance broken.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add 'pending_dependencies' to WorkItemStatus enum in Source/Shared/types/workflow.ts. Coordinate with api-contract agent before editing — this is a shared type change affecting multiple layers.

p2_findings.title: BlockedBadge missing amber Pending Dependencies state
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-blocked-badge specifies three render states; only two are implemented. The amber badge (status='pending_dependencies') is entirely absent — no status prop, no amber color, no test. Blocked on QO-002.
p2_findings.impact: Users see no visual indicator for pending-dependency state. Spec compliance gap.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add status prop to BlockedBadge. Implement amber 'Pending Dependencies' render state and test. Gated on QO-002 (enum must exist first).

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store.* directly, bypassing service layer
p2_findings.description: workItems.ts and workflow.ts both call the in-memory store directly from route handlers. Only dashboard.ts follows the service pattern. Architecture rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
p2_findings.impact: Business logic entangled in route layer. Makes testing harder, violates architecture contract.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract store calls from workItems.ts and workflow.ts into service modules. Follow the dashboardService pattern.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-001 to FR-TMP-010 have zero traceability in Source/
p2_findings.description: 10 tiered-merge-pipeline FRs exist in specs but are unresolvable in Source/ — they live in platform/ (orchestrator infrastructure), which pipeline agents cannot touch. These FRs are out of scope for Source/ traceability checks.
p2_findings.impact: Enforcer cannot validate these FRs, creating a false coverage gap in reporting.
p2_findings.recommendation: Update Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md or enforcer config to explicitly mark FR-TMP-* as platform-layer scope. Add a platform-scope annotation so the enforcer can skip them without false failures.

p2_findings.title: Express 4 → 5 major version gap
p2_findings.description: Express 5.x includes breaking API changes and security hardening. Current 4.x versions still receive security patches but are 2+ major versions behind. Upgrade requires code review of middleware and route handlers.
p2_findings.impact: Missing security hardening in Express 5. Future CVEs in 4.x will have no upstream fix.
p2_findings.recommendation: Plan express@5 migration for next major cycle. Test with express@5 in dev, update middleware/route handler code.
